baseline.role: Accepted M28 gameplay; no archive/cache is a build prerequisite

release/m23/assembly-cache.json.method: Checked-in authored NESASM spans, source-text keyed; reconstruct blank assembler container and validate output SHA256. Only authored emitted spans, no commercial banks; no assembler required for packaging/preparation.

release/m24-special/palette-assembly.jso.method: Checked-in authored code and symbols; consumer validates input/code SHA256 before applying guarded writes.

release/m241/palette-assembly.json.method: Checked-in authored selector code and symbols; input/code hash-bound cache, validated during production preparation.

release/m243/poison-assembly.json.method: Checked-in project-native edit spans with source/assembler provenance and original-source guards.

release/m244/sun-native.json.method: Checked-in accepted authored hook/helper edit spans, identity and exact source guards; original ROM bytes supplied locally.

release/m245/menu-native.json.method: Checked-in authored NESASM code spans; source_text_sha256/output_sha256 verified. Runtime inserts owned-ROM local glyphs/metatiles; these are not package assets.

release/m25-foundation/sfx-native.json.method: Checked-in authored code cache, source/code/helper SHA256 plus original-source guards. Restoration-only accepted SFX helper.

release/m25/native-symbols.json.method: Checked-in minimal symbol names/offsets retained from the accepted native research. No score payload or ROM bank. M26 does not regenerate an upstream disassembly or require a private research checkout.

release/m26/giant-assembly.json.method: Pinned NESASM certificate of authored giant selector only; exact source and executable hashes checked at preparation; no assembler needed for packaging or player preparation.

build: Git checkout with committed recipe inputs
prerequisites.optional_music: Only separately versioned private builds; unavailable in this public flavor
player: owned canonical SMB3 USA Revision A ROM

seed_policy: No historical development denylist; all identity/ROM/cache/checkpoint checks retained

transformations.crlf: Normalize checkout CRLF to LF, then emit canonical CRLF to preserve the sealed runtime representation.
transformations.lf: Normalize checkout CRLF to LF; retain all other bytes.
transformations.managed_config: Parse checked-in JSON; LastRomPath=.; UpdateAutoCheckEnabled=false; indent=2 sorted keys LF plus terminal newline.
transformations.path_substitutions: Pinned source normalization; no developer checkout is a build input.
